claim: often as a single cuvee drawing on all seven permitted varieties
because: Since the revised Champagne cahier des charges was published in the Journal Officiel on 10 December 2022, after INAO approved it in November 2022, the fungus-resistant hybrid Voltis has also been authorised. It is on a trial basis, limited to 5% of an estate's vineyard area and 10% of a blend. So Champagne now has eight permitted varieties, not seven. The multi-variety cuvees the explanation has in mind are built on the seven historic varieties.
fix: often as a single cuvee drawing on all seven historic varieties (the hybrid Voltis has also been permitted on trial since 2022)
